title: Linguistic Relativity: Does Language Shape Thought?
grammar: The Sapir-Whorf Hypothesis and Linguistic Relativity in Hungarian
goal: I can explain the strong and the weak version of the Sapir-Whorf hypothesis.
I can discuss whether Hungarian preverbs (*igekötők*) shape how speakers see events.
I can argue for or against linguistic determinism in a short text.
